messages:
kevin (billing): follow-up from the postmortem  short summary: delayed token attribution from the write-ack path produced undercounted invoices for a small set. need owners for detection rule, ledger backfill, invoice adjustments vs credit notes, and a customer outreach plan.
zoe (eng-infra): i'll own detection + quick dashboard. plan: emit metric 'write_ack_delay_ms' and rule -> #metering-alerts. ETA tomorrow noon. will attach sample traces to ticket.
harper (finance): i'll take credits and invoice adjustments. please provide final CSV with invoice_id,customer_id,token_delta,est_usd. prefer to apply credit notes for deltas <$750 to avoid reissue tax work.
drew (eng-sre): root cause: occasional stuck flush in Producer v1 when disk io contention spikes caused delayed acks. mitigation: add flush timeout + quick retry window. PR in 48h, canary 72h after. also adding nightly drift detector.
li (customer-success): i'll draft two comms templates: short credit notification and a reissue notice. for customers > $5k MRR we do AE-assisted outreach before any reissue.
kevin (billing): preliminary extract (prelim):
```csv
invoice_id,customer_id,window,token_delta
inv_20260512_007,cust_512,2026-05-12T02:00Z-02:20Z,-430
inv_20260512_009,cust_078,2026-05-12T02:05Z-02:30Z,-120
```
harper (finance): question on rounding policy: propose nearest 25 tokens for <$2k/mo, nearest 200 for >$2k/mo. reissue threshold $1,000 USD or tax-jurisdiction flagged.
kevin (billing): approved. i'll add 'requires_approval' and 'requires_tax_review' columns in the runbook extract.
zoe (eng-infra): detection rule sample: "write_ack_delay_ms > 45000 AND estimated_missing_tokens > 100" -> creates ticket MET-6021 with links.
billing-bot: Ticket MET-6021 created: "write_ack_delay -> undercounted tokens" assigned to eng-infra.
harper (finance): timeline: once detection provides final list, aim to apply credits for <$750 deltas within 2 business days; reissues or >$750 with tax flags in 5 business days.
drew (eng-sre): i'll add the flush-timeout, watchdog, and nightly drift job (ETA 6d). PR will include histogram 'late_write_ms'.
li (customer-success): i'll queue AE outreach for affected enterprise customers and hold public comms until credits post. template draft in 18h.
kevin (billing): action recap: zoe -> detection + MET-6021 (tomorrow noon); drew -> PR for flush-timeout + watchdog (PR 48h, canary 72h); harper -> credit/runbook + AR CSV (2bd autos < $750); li -> comms + AE outreach (18h). i'll update the postmortem follow-up doc and schedule a 48h checkpoint. :white_check_mark:
